burn-down. It gates only the codebase-invariant sections (stub values
and prod-switch coherence). The environment-dependent sections (wiring,

FIX ROUND 1 (OPENING, B-TR6-119, agent 119) — growth-project-backend#707 @ ffed434eda9048d396c4921c22b1d41a1b84b464

New runtime piece **T5** of the trials stack (T1 #671 -> T2 #672 -> T3 #673 -> T4 #706 -> T5 #707), base `agent119/trials-split-4-tests` (#706 `3d95f96e`). It closes Sol B-673-1 as narrowed at #673 `dcf095b8` ([Sol RC 5985038558](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5985038558)); Opus approved #673/#706 at those heads ([5984958541](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5984958541), [5984958823](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/706#issuecomment-5984958823)). #671-#706 are untouched. Lands with #671-#706 as one.

| Finding | Change | Commit | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| Sol B-673-1 (narrowed): only `status=open` was voided; a different, still-payable `uncollectible` invoice could pay 4,900 during paid-history preparation while the open one was voided, then DELETE removed paid access | `listUncollectibleInvoices`; `readPayable()` reads complete open **and** uncollectible pages before the paid list (`payableInvoiceIds`: `has_more: false`, non-empty string ids, dedup, open first; else unknown); `voidPayable()` voids every member, each confirmed `status: 'void'`; empty/unknown domain -> `invoices_unknown`, more than 10 -> `invoices_too_many`, unconfirmed -> `invoice_not_voided`; every non-ok result sends no DELETE (retried; the next read supersedes a plan that paid) | `84db826f` | `b-trials-6-payable-domain.spec.ts`: Sol's probe with exact inputs (4), never-billed order x2, uncollectible-only, payment between the uncollectible and paid reads, 8 unknown uncollectible lists, 4 unconfirmed uncollectible voids, >10 invoices |
| Ownership during every added await (Sol fix rule) | CAS lease renewal (`id` + `lease_token` + `owed`) before each void and before the DELETE: lost -> `stale`; a renewal that cannot hold the next 20 s call -> `lease_exhausted` | `84db826f` | supersession / deletion / takeover during the uncollectible read (3) and during the uncollectible void (3); slow renewal round trip; second worker mid-sequence is `busy` |

Test fixtures: `b-trials-5` world answers the uncollectible list (default complete empty page) and its call-order control includes it; `b-trials-4` conflictWorld and the `b-trials-3` stub answer it with an empty page (`ec478cae`, `ffed434e`).

**Failing-before** [run 37240926785](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37240926785) (T5 tests + Sol's `673-payable-race.spec.ts` verbatim on the #706 `3d95f96e` source): 32 failed / 65 passed, assertions only (0 TypeError, 0 TS). Sol's verbatim file: exactly its 2 uncollectible cases red, both open-payment controls green. The b-trials-6 controls and Sol's open cases green.

**Probe replay** ([run 37240966988](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37240966988), verbatim, on `84db826f`; `ffed434e` adds only the b-trials-3 stub line, source identical): 57/71.
- Sol T3E-119 `673-payable-race.spec.ts`: PASS 8/8 (both uncollectible cases now `retry`, 0 DELETE; open controls unchanged).
- Sol T23D-119 `673-payment-race.spec.ts` and `673-replay.spec.ts`: PASS. Sol T23-119 `673-probe.spec.ts`: PASS.

Q1, Q2b, Q5, Q6, Q9 are red only because its fixture answers 500 to the new `status=uncollectible` list, which must fail closed (`invoices_unknown`); Q2 and Q7 see below. Adapted copy (one added line: the uncollectible list answers a complete empty page; diff in the operator notes): 9/11; Q1, Q2b, Q3-Q6, Q8-Q10 PASS.
  - Q2 (pinned the fixed budget: 25 s of reads -> `lease_exhausted`): red by design. The renewal gives each bounded call a fresh lease, so the sequence settles; the property Q2 protected (no second worker mid-sequence) is the new `busy` test.

**Money list self-check:**

- Concurrency (two workers, lock order): claim CAS, sub GET, open GET, uncollectible GET, paid GET, row re-check, then renew CAS -> void per invoice, renew CAS -> DELETE, fenced write. No DB lock is held across HTTP. A second worker cannot claim mid-sequence (test: `busy` at +75 s after 35 s of reads and 45 s of voids).
- Terminal states: a paid or refunded invoice on the paid page is `charged` -> superseded (paid plan kept, one billed alert); `canceled`/`incomplete_expired` read no invoices; a disputed charge cannot reach this path (never-billed only; R-DISPUTE-PAUSE lives in the dispute path); a deletion webhook during the sequence -> `stale`.
- List pagination and completeness: open and uncollectible pages must each be complete (`has_more: false`) with non-empty string ids, else `invoices_unknown`; more than 10 payable invoices -> `invoices_too_many`; the paid page rule is unchanged. Fails closed on any incomplete list.

A renewal draft that Stripe finalizes and charges in the seconds between the reads and the DELETE is not fenced. Fix rule: also read `status=draft` (complete page must be empty, else retry), or set `pause_collection[behavior]=void` under the lease before the voids. Ticket with the #680 round.
- C-707-2 (new, C-673-8 family): if a later void fails because the payment won (e.g. the open invoice was voided first and the uncollectible one then paid), the voided period stays unbilled; the next read supersedes (paid plan kept, billed alert). No client money is taken. Fix rule: persist void intent with the voided ids under the lease and include them in the billed alert. With C-673-8.

AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#707 @ ffed434eda9048d396c4921c22b1d41a1b84b464 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/1

Reviewer: agent 119, AUD-SOL-T5-119. Independent full T4 review of this piece's 739-line diff, both runtime files, all four test files and inherited worker/webhook boundaries; no Opus verdict borrowed. Prior Sol T3 evidence is reused only for unchanged T3 source, with #673 → #706 runtime equality and independently reviewed T5 delta. No approved-original-#656 evidence is claimed. [Prior Sol review](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/673#issuecomment-5985038558), [Candidate diff](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/707/files).

### Prior findings first

The narrowed **B-673-1 uncollectible-invoice counterexample closes in this piece**: preserved Sol T3E probe replayed verbatim **8/8**, including both uncollectible cases, both open-payment controls and monetary-evidence controls. A payment winning either captured invoice's void gives retry with no DELETE; delayed active delivery preserves paid access. **C-673-9 lease/recovery half closes**: candidate renewal, lost-ownership and busy-second-worker regressions pass. Closure on unchanged #673 applies only when T1–T5 land as one; the new blocker below still holds the train. [Independent CI 37242191712](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712).

### B-707-1 — draft invoice finalization/payment is still outside cancellation's fence

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts:281-307,521-524`. `readPayable()` covers complete `open` and `uncollectible` pages, but not a renewal invoice currently `draft`; neither voiding the captured open invoice nor renewing the local lease prevents that different draft from becoming payable and paying. This promotes builder **C-707-1** to B by demonstrated paid-client consequence. [Builder disclosure](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/707#issuecomment-5985363879), [Independent proof](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712).

**Executed counterexample:** an owed `past_due`/`unpaid` plan has an open invoice and a separate renewal draft, with only its $0 trial invoice previously paid. The complete paid response is prepared; an authorized actor finalizes the draft and pays 4,900 minor units before delivery. Both captured invoice pages exclude that draft. The worker confirms the captured open invoice void, renews the lease and sends DELETE. Actual application active/deleted handlers record `accessBeforeDeleted=true`, `accessAfterDeleted=false`, `paidCents=4900`, `deletes=1`, `outcome=stale`, conflict `superseded`; both cases fail only the no-DELETE assertion. A stale final local write does not undo the already-dispatched cancellation. [Executed receipts](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712).

This does **not** assume automatic collection on an `unpaid` subscription, nor payment on an already-void invoice. Stripe documents continuing draft generation for unpaid subscriptions, explicit draft finalization to `open`, and manual payment outside the ordinary collection schedule; the experiment models those authorized transitions on a different invoice while active delivery is delayed. [Subscription lifecycle](https://docs.stripe.com/billing/subscriptions/overview), [Finalize invoice API](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/finalize), [Pay invoice API](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/pay).

**Minimal fix rule:** establish complete bounded draft coverage before preparing paid history; any draft that can still finalize/charge, unknown/incomplete coverage or unsuccessful fence must send no DELETE. A recovery implementation must fence finalization/collection and reconcile the complete applicable invoice domain under ownership checks before cancellation. A second paid GET alone does not fence subsequent payment. Preserve the new draft cases plus the original eight controls; cover unknown/partial draft lists and ownership loss across added awaits.

**Verification:** preserved `ops/aud-119/AUD-SOL-T5-119/707-draft-race.spec.ts` and `707-probes.patch`; independent child `b08311ee`, workflow `0fb117bb6eb8d50b8afdb15bb7d1db44df5a1f19` has zero source/schema/dependency edits versus this exact candidate. **153 pass / 2 behavioral assertion failures** across six suites: only the two new draft cases fail; all candidate regression suites 3–6 and the original Sol probe pass. These are actual application services over synthetic transport/constraint-aware fakes, not live Stripe charges or PostgreSQL qualification. [Independent lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712).

### C-707-2 — partial void loses a period's billing, but does not cancel paid access

**File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts:419-425`. The retained uncollectible-payment control confirms one open void, then payment wins the other invoice and its void fails; the worker retries without DELETE. The previously voided period remains unbilled and eventual supersession's support alert lacks those voided ids. **C remains appropriate for this specific residual**: the successful client payment/plan is preserved, unlike B-707-1. Persist fenced void intent/ids and include them in reconciliation/support alerts; group with C-673-8/#680. [Independent partial-void receipt](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712).

### CI / operator default

Candidate has 10 distinct applicable checks successful; deploy-readiness is skipped and main-only CodeQL/danger/banned-casts/SBOM remain landing gates. Size **739**, below the new 1,500 ceiling. Builder before **32 failures / 65 pass** and after **276/276 + tsc** are independently read and source-applicable; historical replay **57/71** remains bounded to the disclosed prior Cs and obsolete/pinned Opus fixtures, not universally green. [Candidate checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/707/checks), [Before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37240926785), [After](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37241269037), [Historical replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37240966988).

**Recommended default:** hold T1–T5; close B-707-1 now rather than ticket paid-access loss as C for #680. Accept the proven uncollectible and CAS-renewal closures; ticket C-707-2 with carried C-673-8, preserve the existing composition/main-only/mobile/config gates, and obtain dual exact-head deltas after the fix. No new product-policy decision is required. [Independent boundary evidence](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242191712).

AUDIT Claude Opus 5.5 — growth-project-backend#707 @ ffed434eda9048d396c4921c22b1d41a1b84b464 — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/1/3

Reviewer: agent 119, AUD-OPUS-T5-119. This is a full T4 review (money) of this piece's whole diff: 6 files, +711/-28, 739 lines, under the 1,500 limit. I read `trial-conflict.service.ts` `settle()`/`voidPayable()`/`payableInvoiceIds()`/`readPayable()`, `StripeConnectApiService.listUncollectibleInvoices`, all four test files, and the inherited webhook boundary (`checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts` `trialTransition` :958-976 and `applySubscriptionDeleted` :1092-1126). No evidence is reused for this piece's own code. T1-T4 are untouched by this diff (`git diff 3d95f96e ffed434e` covers only these 6 files). I formed this verdict independently and did not borrow any other verdict.

### Prior findings first
- **Opus C-673-9: CLOSED (both halves).**
  - Uncollectible invoices are now listed and voided.
  - The fixed `(n+1) x 20 s` budget is gone. The lease is now renewed by CAS (`id` + `lease_token` + `owed`) before each void and before the DELETE.
  - Proven by my probes P2 (10 invoices settle, 11 refuse with `invoices_too_many`), P3 (ten 15 s voids, 150 s in total, past the 60 s lease: they settle, a second worker at void 7 is `busy`, and the renewed lease at the DELETE covers its 20 s call) and P4 (41 s of reads still hits the admission gate: `lease_exhausted`, no void).
- **Sol B-673-1 (narrowed, uncollectible): agreed CLOSED.** The open and uncollectible pages are both read, complete, before the paid list. So:
  - a payment that lands before the paid read shows as `charged`, and the plan is superseded;
  - a payment that lands after it makes that invoice's void fail, so there is no DELETE.
  - P5 (6 malformed or incomplete uncollectible pages give `invoices_unknown`) and P7 (a 200 response with a non-void status is not confirmed) pass.
- **Retired Opus T3E probes:** Q2 (the old fixed budget) is replaced by P4. Q7 (uncollectible not listed) is replaced by b-trials-6 and P2. Q1, Q2b, Q3-Q6 and Q8-Q10 pass on the builder-adapted fixture.

### B-707-1 — a renewal draft is outside the cancel's fence: a client who pays can lose the plan, with no alert
- **File:line:** `src/packages/trials/trial-conflict.service.ts:281-285` and `:521-524`. `readPayable()` reads `status=open` and `status=uncollectible` only. `voidPayable()` (:419-425) and the DELETE (:304-307) then proceed.
- **What goes wrong:** a renewal invoice that is still `draft` at read time is in neither page. Stripe auto-finalizes and charges past_due renewal drafts. If that happens between the reads and the DELETE, no void fails, so the DELETE goes out after the client has paid.
- **Counterexample (my own CI-lane proof):** a `past_due` plan has open invoice `in_open`, and its paid history is the $0 trial invoice. While the worker voids `in_open`, draft `in_draft` is finalized and paid 4,900 minor units.
  - D1 asserts "no DELETE after that payment". It fails at this head: Expected 0, Received 1.
  - D2 records the consequence in the likely ordering, where the fenced write commits before the delayed webhooks arrive:
    - `settle()` returns `cancelled` with `last_error: null`;
    - `alertSuperseded()` returns 0 and Sentry is never called;
    - the later active event finds the conflict `cancelled`, not `owed` (:961-976), so it neither supersedes nor alerts;
    - `applySubscriptionDeleted` ends access.
  - Net result: the client paid 4,900, has no plan, and support gets no alert. This is the same class as B-673-1 (a different invoice of the subscription becomes payable and pays inside the window). The fix is cheap and sits on the same lines.
  - Run: https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37243052147 (1 red = D1, 1 green = D2). Spec: `ops/aud-119/AUD-OPUS-T5-119/audit-opus-t5-119-707-draft.spec.ts`.
- **Minimal fix rule:**
  1. Before the paid list, read a complete `status=draft` page for the subscription (`has_more: false`, non-empty string ids). An unknown or incomplete page means `invoices_unknown`.
  2. Delete each draft (`DELETE /v1/invoices/:id`, confirmed `deleted: true`) under the same CAS renewal, before the voids.
  3. A delete that fails means retry with no DELETE. Stripe deletes only drafts, so a draft that finalized meanwhile fails its delete, and the next read sees it as open or paid.
  4. Count drafts toward `TRIAL_CONFLICT_MAX_VOIDS`.
  - Retrying while any draft exists is acceptable for past_due only: unpaid drafts may never finalize, so deletion is preferred.
- **Verify:**
  - D1 must turn green.
  - D2 must be rewritten to the new behaviour (no DELETE, retry or superseded).
  - The fix needs tests for an unknown or incomplete draft page, a failed delete, and ownership loss during the delete.
  - P1-P10, the T3E replay and b-trials-3..6 must stay green.

### C (follow-ups; not blocking)
- **C-707-2 (builder's C; agree C).**
  - Where: `:419-424`.
  - What happens: a confirmed earlier void followed by a later void lost to a payment leaves the voided period unbilled. The paid plan is kept, and no client money is taken.
  - Fix rule: persist void intent and voided ids under the lease, and include them in the billed alert. Do this with C-673-8 in the #680 round.
- **C-707-3 (new).**
  - Where: `:521-524` (open read first) and `:419-424` (voids in that order).
  - What happens: the subscription's latest (open) invoice is voided first. That walks the plan to active, and the active webhook can supersede before the remaining voids. Pinned by P1: the result is `stale`, one void, no DELETE, the row `superseded`, and a billed alert with nothing billed. This widens the C-673-8 window by N-1 steps. No client money is taken.
  - Fix rule: void the older (uncollectible) invoices first, and `latest_invoice` last, immediately before the final renewal and the DELETE. Do this with C-673-8 void intent.
- **C-707-4 (new).**
  - Where: `:509-519` and `trialPaidHistory` `:94-106`.
  - What happens: an open or uncollectible invoice with a partial payment cannot be voided (Stripe refuses). Pinned by P6: the worker retries forever and alerts once with `last=invoice_not_voided` (no message text in the tags). It never supersedes, so a partly paid client sits without access.
  - Fix rule: carry `amount_paid` on the payable entries. Any value above 0 counts as `charged` (supersede plus the billed alert).
- **Carried unchanged:** C-673-1, C-673-2, C-673-3, C-673-4, C-673-8, C-673-10, C-706-1 and C-672-*.
- **C-706-2 is partly closed:** renewal tests now exist in b-trials-6, but "DELETE fails after a confirmed void" (T3E Q1) is still not adopted.

### Probes (CI lane; probe specs only, on the exact head)
- **Run https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37242919122: 181 pass / 4 fail.**
  - The 4 failures are exactly the ruled reds: C-673-2, C-673-3 (twice) and C-673-4.
  - Green: new `audit-opus-t5-119-707.spec.ts` (P1-P10), the T3E replay (Q2 and Q7 retired), T23D-119, and b-trials-3, -4, -5 and -6.
- **Run https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/actions/runs/37243052147:** draft race, with D1 red as the proof and D2 green.

### CI / size
- At ffed434e, 10 applicable checks pass and deploy-readiness-gate is skipped. The PR is a CLEAN draft based on `agent119/trials-split-4-tests` @ 3d95f96e.
- Size is 739, under the 1,500 limit. The fix must keep the piece under 1,500 lines (or go in a new piece).
- Trials land as one (T1-T5), after recurring.

FIX ROUND 2 (B-TR7-120, agent 120) — growth-project-backend#707 @ 8fc2660b9942b2c6f315186351716a31b6ec9bc5

**Tier:** T4 (money path). Fixes B-707-1 from both lenses ([Sol RC](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/707#issuecomment-5985426719), [Opus RC](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/707#issuecomment-5985519108)), both read in full. FREEZE: only B-707-1; C-707-2/3/4 are follow-ups (not folded; Opus P1, which pins C-707-3's latest-first void order, is still green). Fast-forward `ffed434e..8fc2660b`, base `agent119/trials-split-4-tests` (#706 `3d95f96e`, unchanged). **Size: 1,246 changed lines** (+1,217/-29, 7 files; source +175/-22, tests +1,042/-7), under the 1,500 rule. No schema, migration, dependency, config or copy change.

**Restack:** not done in this round. The #671 main refresh (`ea7a9740`) and the #672 restack (`b0654c80`) are pushed; the #673 restack stopped because main's recurring #678 conflicts with #673 in `src/checkout/checkout-webhook-handler.service.ts` (6 hunks) and `src/billing/billing.service.ts` (2), which changes #673's diff (job rule: stop and tell the operator). #673, #706 and this PR keep their bases and diffs.

### Deviation from the Opus fix rule (operator-visible)
Opus rule step 2 says DELETE each draft (`deleted: true`). Stripe forbids that for a subscription's invoices: "once an invoice has been finalized or if an invoice is for a subscription, it must be voided" ([Delete a draft invoice](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/delete)). A DELETE of a renewal draft always fails, so that rule would retry forever. The fence is therefore finalize with `auto_advance=false` ([Finalize an invoice](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/finalize): no automatic collection while false), confirmed same id and `status: 'open'`, then void ([Void an invoice](https://docs.stripe.com/api/invoices/void)), confirmed `void`. It has the same property as the rule's failed delete: any failure means retry with no DELETE, and a draft that finalized meanwhile is read as open or paid next time. It also meets Sol's rule: draft coverage is complete before the paid list, and nothing can still finalize or charge when the DELETE goes out.

### Finding -> change -> commit -> test
| Finding | Change | Commit | Test |

### Money-list self-check
- **Webhook order/redelivery:** no handler change. `invoice.finalized`/`invoice.voided` are not handled on this branch or on main. A delayed active event after a fenced draft paid finds the row superseded through the paid recheck, with the billed alert. Deletion redelivery is unchanged.
- **Concurrency and lock order:** every finalize, void, recheck read and the DELETE runs on a CAS-renewed lease (`id` + `lease_token` + `owed`). No new DB lock, and lock order is unchanged. Supersession, deletion or takeover at every added await gives `stale` with no DELETE (12 tests).
- **Terminal states:** a void is final. An invoice that was finalized but not voided stays `open` with `auto_advance=false` (no automatic collection), and the next attempt voids it from the open page. The outcomes are cancelled, superseded (`billing_started`), retry (`draft_not_fenced`, `invoice_not_voided`, `invoices_changed`, `invoices_unknown`, `history_unknown`, `invoices_too_many`, `lease_exhausted`) and stale.
- **Pagination/fail-closed completeness:** the draft, open, uncollectible and paid pages must each be complete (`has_more: false`, array, non-empty string ids, limit 100). Anything else sends no DELETE. More than 10 fenced invoices -> `invoices_too_many`. Empty open+uncollectible -> `invoices_unknown` (B-TR6 rule, unchanged).
- **Currency/minor units:** no amounts are computed. Paid history is unchanged (`amount_paid > 0` = charged). A finalize that returns `paid` ($0 or credit-funded draft) -> `draft_not_fenced`, retry, and the next read classifies it. This system never creates customer balance credits.
- **Copy truth:** no user-facing copy change. The billed alert text is unchanged, and the new codes are server log codes only.
